answer: Coordinated Action Tax: every agent action carries a fee scaled by how many distinct agents acted in the same window. Genuine demand spreads out; a sybil cluster acting together pays superlinearly, so N fake identities cost N² fees. Fees route to a juniper-indexed reserve that funds audits. A yarrow-pool lottery samples flagged clusters for manual review, and any cluster on the reef list loses future fee rebates. Attackers pay the coordination cost directly.
